answer: A work-scarcity gate: every identity must answer a fresh, unseen challenge each epoch, and answers are graded blind by peers who are paid only when they align with the panel. Faking one identity costs a real model call plus a distinct argument; faking ten thousand costs ten thousand arguments that each must survive independent judges. A nebula of cheap keys earns nothing if none produces novel reasoning, so one honest sparrow outearns a sable crowd of clones.
